messages:
leo: tiny mood check  looking for a one-off comfort film for tonight  something gentle, a touch wistful, ~90-120m, plus a 2-song afterlist for credits. hit me with your best quiet recs. 

emily: The Farewell is perfect for that  bittersweet and warm. two-song chaser: 1) Feist - 'The Limit To Your Love', 2) Sufjan Stevens - 'To Be Alone With You' :relaxed:

jules: Lost in Translation if you want sleepy neon + distance. songs: 1) Kevin Shields - 'Mamor', 2) Cigarettes After Sex - 'Apocalypse'

noah: Big Fish gives you the fairytale sadness + catharsis. songs: 1) Tom Waits - 'I Don't Want to Grow Up', 2) Regina Spektor - 'Samson'

leo: all great. any offbeat picks anyone cherishes but that people might skip over?

tara: try In the Mood for Love  visually lush and quietly heartbreaking. tiny playlist: 1) Nat King Cole - 'Quizas, Quizas, Quizas', 2) Shigeru Umebayashi - 'Yumeji's Theme'

emily: if you want something micro & cozy: The Station Agent (low-key good). songs: 1) Iron & Wine - 'The Trapeze Swinger', 2) Calexico - 'All Systems Red'

jules: vote time: pick your watch+chaser for Saturday evening office movie night (we're making a poll here): 
leo: A) Lost in Translation + Kevin Shields // B) The Farewell + Feist // C) In the Mood for Love + Nat King Cole

noah: A
tara: C
emily: B

jules: tally: A gets 1, B gets 1, C gets 1  tie. 
leo: tie-breaker: who wants subtitles vs dub? if most are subtitles we'll lean In the Mood for Love (C)

emily: subtitles here

noah: subtitles too
tara: subtitles

jules: subtitles wins, so C it is unless someone objects.

squad-bot: automated message: pinned playlist 'office-movie-night-credit-chasers' to #playlists. :robot_face:

leo: sweet. jules, can you add the two-song chasers to the pinned playlist? also, heads-up: move movie night to next Sat 7pm in the kitchen lounge. short pitch snacks welcome.

jules: yup I'll add them and DM Spotify links to folks who asked. also I can bring tea + ginger cookies.

emily: I'll grab a tiny projector bulb + throw extra cushions. 

noah: if anyone wants the two-song links now, DM me and Ill drop YouTube/Spotify.

leo: thanks team  excited for a low-key cinema night.
